links.outcome: Readability of AI-simplified versus original discharge summaries (Flesch-Kincaid grade level and ease score)
links.effect: 39.6% reduction in Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and 106.37% increase in Ease Score; mean PEMAT-P understandability 77.71, actionability 52.12.
links.quote: AI-generated summaries demonstrated significant improvements in readability, with a 39.6% reduction in Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and a 106.37% increase in Ease Score.

links.outcome: Omissions and hallucinations in AI-simplified discharge summaries
links.effect: 10.8% of summaries had omissions and 7.5% had hallucinations, with corrections made in some cases; mean accuracy 5.21/6.
links.quote: However, 10.8% of summaries had omissions, and 7.5% had hallucinations, with corrections made in some cases.
